content.prompt:
A lawn sprinkler has an arm 75 cm long that spins around its centre.
Calculate the distance the end of the arm travels if it spins a total of $1530^{\circ}$.
Give your answer in metres rounded to two decimal places.

answer.worked:
The arm is the radius of the circular path.
$$\begin{align*}r&=\frac{75}{100}=0.75\text{ m}\\\text{Revolutions}&=\frac{1530}{360}=4.25\\\text{Distance}&=4.25\times2\pi r\\\text{Distance}&=4.25\times2\pi\times0.75\\\text{Distance}&=6.375\pi\text{ m}\\\text{Distance}&\approx20.03\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

content.prompt: Find the perimeter of this shape. Answer to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
The top side is $8\text{ cm}$, so the dashed radius is $8\text{ cm}$. The single ticks show the sloping radius is also $8\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}l&=\frac{40}{360}\times2\pi\times8\\P&=5+8+5+8+\frac{40}{360}\times2\pi\times8\\P&=26+\frac{16\pi}{9}\\P&\approx31.6\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
